title: Netresearch project manifest
description: Machine-readable source of truth for one Netresearch open-source project. Produced by the project's own repository at build time and published at <pages-root>/project-manifest.json. Never maintained editorially in a consuming site.

manifest_version.description: Schema revision this document conforms to.

name.description: Product name as shown to humans, e.g. 'nr-llm'.

slug.description: Canonical path of the product page below https://netresearch.github.io, e.g. '/t3x-nr-llm/'.

stage.description: Maturity. Drives the status badge and the wording of every claim on the page.

latest_release.description: Tag of the most recent published release, e.g. 'v0.28.0'. null when the project has never been released.

main_version.description: Version currently on the default branch. May be ahead of latest_release; the two are different values and must be labelled differently.

docs_version.description: Version the published documentation describes. May lag both other values.

last_verified.description: Date a human last checked the product page's non-derived claims. Distinct from any version.

owner.description: Accountable owner for the page's business and governance copy (team or GitHub handle).

typo3_versions.description: Supported TYPO3 versions, verified against composer.json / ext_emconf.php.

php_versions.description: Supported PHP versions, verified against composer.json.

capabilities.description: Shipped functionality. Each entry carries its own evidence link.

security_controls.description: Implemented security controls. Describes controls the software supports — never a compliance verdict.

cost_controls.description: Budgets, limits and analytics the software implements.

demo.description: A demo that actually works. null when none exists — never point at a placeholder.

evidence.description: Links backing the page's claims: releases, code, ADRs, tests, measurements.

ai.description: Present only for products with an AI surface. Renders as the AI Capability Card.

id.description: Stable anchor id, so the claim stays citable across releases.

state.description: Keeps planned, experimental, implemented and measured apart. Anything other than 'planned' requires evidence.

aiCapabilityCard.description: The shared AI Capability Card. Every AI product renders the same fields, so the pages stay comparable.
